Mikey and Aaron built a million-subscriber YouTube brand on reaction content before accidentally falling into paranormal investigation. Now they run five channels in four days a week, fund independent horror films, and somehow still have time to get terrorized by racist ghosts on a Spirit Box.

On this episode of the HORRORble Podcast, they walk through the investigation that made them believers (Yorktown Memorial Hospital), the one that confirmed ghosts are absolutely real (Emily Morgan Hotel near the Alamo in San Antonio), and the one that proved demons exist (McInteer Villa in Atchison, Kansas). Aaron's Estes method session in an incinerator room nearly broke him physically. A tripod moved on its own in their studio. Balloons floated with no airflow. Disembodied footsteps paced above them while the caretaker was miles away.

This is one of the best haunted locations in Texas conversations we have had on this show, and it goes way beyond Texas. Askia also opens up about walking away from professional basketball to bet on himself with the podcast, and the guys share the mindset that kept Aaron going when he was sleeping in his car outside Mikey's house: "Live, dream, succeed."

If you are into true scary stories podcast content or just want to hear two dudes get called out by a Spirit Box in a Civil War-era basement, this one is for you. Internet City ghost hunting content hits different when they tell it live.
